note: Proposals for the 13 holds raised by the 2026-11-16 source-scope review packets. Proposed tasks stay inside the official row wording as read through a web reader. Mode-only proposals (PA22.4, PA22.5, PY11.6, SU5.2) cite a second, non-official reproduction of the same table; that corroborates but does not replace a rendered-page check of the official PDF. Original draft tasks and packets are unchanged. No clinician review, faculty acceptance or canonical mapping.
acceptanceRequires: Rendered-page check of the official NMC row (domain, level, wording).
Explicit owner or faculty acceptance recorded as a versioned objective revision.

records.originalDraftTask: Observe pH measurement, amino acid paper chromatography and protein electrophoresis and explain what each technique measures.
records.priorHeldReason: The official row lists eleven techniques to observe (pH meter, paper chromatography of amino acids, protein electrophoresis, TLC, PAGE, ISE electrolyte analysis, ABG analyser, ELISA, immunodiffusion, autoanalyser and DNA isolation); the draft names only the first three.
records.proposedCurriculumBoundTask: Observe and explain what is measured by the pH meter, paper chromatography of amino acids, protein electrophoresis, TLC, PAGE, ISE electrolyte analysis, ABG analyser, ELISA, immunodiffusion, autoanalyser and DNA isolation from blood or tissue.

records.originalDraftTask: Role-play responding to a summons and giving evidence, including oath or affirmation, examination, cross-examination and re-examination.
records.priorHeldReason: The official row also names conduct money, types of witnesses, court questions and conduct of the doctor in the witness box; the draft role-play covers summons, oath or affirmation and the three stages of examination only.
records.proposedCurriculumBoundTask: Describe court procedure for a medical witness, covering issue of summons, conduct money, types of witnesses, recording of evidence on oath or affirmation, examination-in-chief, cross-examination, re-examination, court questions and conduct in the witness box, and apply them in a role-play.

records.originalDraftTask: Demonstrate an authorized simulated examination and prepare an objective medico-legal report.
records.priorHeldReason: The official row is the examination of an accused in sexual offence cases, including framing the opinion, preserving and dispatching trace evidence, and discussing objectivity; the draft is a generic authorized examination of an accused person and omits the sexual-offence context and trace evidence.
records.proposedCurriculumBoundTask: In a simulated or supervised setting, examine an alleged accused in a sexual offence case, prepare the report, frame the opinion, preserve and dispatch trace evidence, and discuss how personal views can compromise objectivity and neutrality.

records.originalDraftTask: Explain indications and demonstrate arterial sampling and safety checks on a mannequin.
records.priorHeldReason: The official row is the indications for arterial blood gas analysis and interpretation of the data (S, P); the draft covers indications plus arterial sampling technique on a mannequin and omits interpretation.
records.proposedCurriculumBoundTask: State the indications for arterial blood gas analysis and interpret supplied ABG results, identifying the primary disturbance and the degree of compensation.
records.proposalNote: Sampling technique removed; the official row is indications and interpretation of the data.

records.originalDraftTask: Compare dietary history, anthropometry and clinical assessment methods for a hospitalized patient.
records.priorHeldReason: The official row includes calculation of caloric requirements during illness alongside methods of nutritional assessment; the draft compares assessment methods only.
records.proposedCurriculumBoundTask: Describe methods of nutritional assessment in an adult and calculate the caloric requirements of a patient during illness.

records.originalDraftTask: Classify causes and use history and investigations to distinguish common presentations from those requiring urgent workup.
records.priorHeldReason: The official row asks for the causes, investigations and management of hyperandrogenism; the draft classifies causes and distinguishes presentations needing urgent workup but omits management.
records.proposedCurriculumBoundTask: Enumerate the causes of hyperandrogenism and describe its investigation and management, distinguishing common presentations from those that need urgent workup.

records.originalDraftTask: Compare supracondylar, forearm, distal radius and physeal fractures with pulled elbow, emphasizing neurovascular and compartment risks.
records.priorHeldReason: The official row also covers femoral shaft, tibial and both-bone leg fractures in children and non-accidental injury/child abuse; the draft names supracondylar, forearm, distal radius and physeal fractures and pulled elbow only.
records.proposedCurriculumBoundTask: Describe the mechanism, features, investigation and management of paediatric injuries: supracondylar humeral fracture with neurovascular injury and compartment syndrome, forearm and distal radius fractures, pulled elbow, physeal injuries, and femoral shaft, tibial and both-bone leg fractures; recognize features suggesting non-accidental injury that require safeguarding referral.

records.originalDraftTask: Compare mechanisms and morphological changes that distinguish reversible injury from irreversible injury.
records.priorHeldReason: The official row begins with the etiology of cell injury before the reversible/irreversible distinction; the draft task covers mechanisms and morphology only. Etiology may be carried by PA2.1, but that reliance is not recorded.
records.proposedCurriculumBoundTask: Describe the etiology of cell injury, then distinguish reversible from irreversible injury by mechanism and by the morphology of the injured cell.

records.originalDraftTask: Distinguish hepatocellular, cholestatic and synthetic dysfunction patterns in sample reports.
records.priorHeldReason: The reader returned the domain cell as "KS" with level KH and a certification number; the draft mode is knowledge. Scope itself matches (interpret a liver function panel).
records.proposedCurriculumBoundTask: Describe and interpret the abnormalities in a supplied liver function test panel, distinguishing hepatocellular, cholestatic and synthetic-function patterns.
records.proposalNote: Mode change only. Second source (MGM Pathology CBME) prints domain "KS", level KH, LGT/DOAP teaching, skill assessment and 4 to certify.

records.originalDraftTask: Interpret representative renal function results and explain what they indicate about filtration and associated disturbances.
records.priorHeldReason: The reader returned the domain cell as "KS" with level KH and a certification number; the draft mode is knowledge. Scope itself matches (interpret a renal function panel).
records.proposedCurriculumBoundTask: Describe and interpret the abnormalities in a supplied renal function test panel and state what each abnormal value indicates.
records.proposalNote: Mode change only. Second source (MGM Pathology CBME) prints domain "KS", level KH, LGT/DOAP teaching, skill assessment and 4 to certify.

records.originalDraftTask: Trace loss of tolerance, autoantibody formation and immune-complex injury and relate them to representative organ lesions.
records.priorHeldReason: The official row is limited to defining SLE and describing its pathogenesis; the draft task also relates mechanisms to representative organ lesions.
records.proposedCurriculumBoundTask: Define systemic lupus erythematosus and trace its pathogenesis from loss of self-tolerance to autoantibody and immune-complex formation.
records.proposalNote: Organ-lesion pathology removed; it is not named in the official row.

records.originalDraftTask: Use ray diagrams or an optical model to demonstrate focusing and accommodation and explain correction of common refractive errors.
records.priorHeldReason: The reader returned the row cells as "K S P Y", which does not fit the column pattern; domain reads K but the level cell is unclear, and the draft mode is practical. Scope itself matches (image formation, refractive errors and their management).
records.proposedCurriculumBoundTask: Discuss image formation in the eye, the common refractive errors and the physiological principles of their correction, using ray diagrams.
records.proposalNote: Mode change only. Second source (MGM Physiology CBME 2024 batch) prints the same garbled "K S P Y" cells but gives "Discuss", LGT/SGT/ECE teaching, written/viva assessment and no certification, which supports knowledge mode.

records.originalDraftTask: Elicit, document and present a structured history of a simulated wound.
records.priorHeldReason: The official row is a communication skill at level SH (elicit, document and present a history in a patient with wounds); the draft task matches that scope but is tagged knowledge mode.
records.proposedCurriculumBoundTask: Elicit, document and present a structured history from a simulated patient presenting with a wound.
